changelog: Unowned supermarkets function automatically as public 24/7 stores allowing all citizens to buy groceries.
Fixed tab content leakage in management UI and redesigned navigation pills with zero text clipping.
Overhauled all user interfaces with neon KPI cards, two-color progress bars, and rich store acquisition modal.
Stores are 100% empty upon player purchase and store owners can repurchase and place any deleted props.
Enhanced shopping cart drawer with cash and bank card payments and eliminated all native JS popups.
